1. Engagement Scope

This document constitutes the final report for the 1989 annual HR compliance audit for Windermere Partners. The scope encompassed a review of 63 policies and procedures, a sample of 10 personnel files, and interviews with 12 HR and payroll staff members.

2. Methodology

The methodology for this review was based on the "Three Lines of Defense" model, assessing the roles and effectiveness of business operations (first line), compliance and risk functions (second line), and internal audit (third line) in managing NASDAQ Listing Rule 5600 Series (board and committee requirements); IRC §4960 (excise tax on excess tax-exempt organization executive compensation) risk.

4. Detailed Findings
KDR-3870-001MEDIUMREMEDIATED
Observation

Union information requests for bargaining unit data were not fulfilled within the required timeframe

Corrective Action Required

Revise the employee handbook to remove language that could be interpreted as restricting employees' Section 7 rights under the NLRA. Submit revised handbook to labor counsel for review within 60 days.

Management Response

This issue has been escalated to the executive steering committee for prioritization and resource allocation. A formal response will be provided following the committee's next scheduled meeting on 1989-07-27.

Owner: Director of Internal Investigations • Due: 1989-10-28
KDR-3674-002INFORMATIONALIN PROGRESS
Observation

Summary Plan Descriptions (SPDs) for 63 benefit plans have not been updated to reflect recent plan amendments

Corrective Action Required

Automate the COBRA notification process to ensure qualifying event notices are generated and mailed within 5 business days of the triggering event.

Management Response

The finding is valid. A budget of $63K has been approved to procure the necessary technology to automate this control. Implementation is projected to take 10 weeks.

Owner: Manager of Corporate Communications • Due: 1989-09-28
KDR-8378-003LOWMONITORING
Observation

Automated employment decision tool bias audit not conducted as required by NYC Local Law 144

Corrective Action Required

The COBRA administration vendor's performance will be audited quarterly to ensure compliance with all statutory notification deadlines, with financial penalties for non-compliance.

Management Response

This finding relates to a legacy system that is scheduled for decommissioning on 1989-07-27. Given the impending system retirement, management has accepted the risk for the interim period and will not invest in remediation for the legacy system.

Owner: Director of Government Relations • Due: 1989-09-28
KDR-5108-004MEDIUMMONITORING
Observation

Salary range disclosure missing from 17% of job postings in jurisdictions requiring it

Corrective Action Required

The HRIS will be audited and reconfigured to ensure FMLA leave entitlement calculations are 100% compliant with the "rolling 12-month period measured backward" method.

Management Response

The finding is acknowledged. This issue was caused by a temporary system outage on 1989-07-27. The system has been restored, and the backlog of affected transactions has been cleared. We consider this matter closed.

Owner: Vice President of Brand • Due: 1989-09-28
KDR-3094-005INFORMATIONALIN PROGRESS
Observation

Summary Plan Descriptions (SPDs) for 63 benefit plans have not been updated to reflect recent plan amendments

Corrective Action Required

Review and revise all pre-employment and post-offer medical questionnaires to remove any questions related to family medical history or genetic information.

Management Response

This finding relates to a legacy system that is scheduled for decommissioning on 1989-07-27. Given the impending system retirement, management has accepted the risk for the interim period and will not invest in remediation for the legacy system.

Owner: Vice President of Government Affairs • Due: 1989-10-28
